findings.title: PatchOperation type returned by createPatch is not exported
findings.why: createPatch's public signature returns PatchOperation[], but src/index.ts only exports the function. Consumers can't name the type without ReturnType<typeof createPatch>. Checked by reading src/index.ts and src/diff.ts.

findings.title: isObject, setMember and clone duplicated from patch.ts
findings.why: merge-patch.ts re-implements three helpers that src/patch.ts already exports, and diff.ts imports them from there. The copies can drift apart, and this one is the odd one out among the modules.
